# python-llm-30

30 Day Challenge to Refresh on Python and LLMs

*Plan generated by Claude*

## Week 1-2: Python Foundations (Days 1-14)

### Days 1-7
- [ ] Set up Python 3.12+
- [ ] Set up an editor
- [ ] Create a virtual environment
- [ ] Set up Git
- [ ] Review core data types
- [ ] Review control flow
- [ ] Review functions
- [ ] Review comprehensions
- [ ] Practice file I/O
- [ ] Practice exception handling
- [ ] Build mini project: CLI tool for CSV or JSON fake customer records

### Days 8-14
- [ ] Learn classes and dataclasses
- [ ] Learn iterators and generators
- [ ] Learn decorators
- [ ] Add type hints
- [ ] Explore standard library: `collections`, `itertools`, `pathlib`, `json`, `argparse`
- [ ] Refactor Week 1 tool into a PII scanner
- [ ] Complete 2-3 easy Exercism Python problems per day

## Week 3: Python for Data and First LLM Calls (Days 15-21)

- [ ] Day 15: Learn `pytest` and project structure
- [ ] Day 16: Learn `pandas` basics and `sqlite3`
- [ ] Day 17: Make first LLM API call with Anthropic Python SDK
- [ ] Day 18: Learn structured outputs with JSON + `pydantic`
- [ ] Day 19: Practice tool use / function calling
- [ ] Day 20: Practice prompting techniques
- [ ] Day 21: Build mini project to classify column sensitivity with LLM output validation

## Week 4: Capstone (Days 22-30)

Pick one capstone and build it end to end, with tests, a README, and a short demo.

### Days 22-30 breakdown
- [ ] Days 22-23: Learn embeddings, chunking, vector store, and RAG basics
- [ ] Days 24-28: Build the capstone and commit to GitHub daily
- [ ] Day 29: Add evals, error handling, logging, and governance notes
- [ ] Day 30: Record a 3-5 minute demo
